key_insight: Random data splits reward memorisation of repeated perovskite recipes, while provenance-grouped evaluation reveals stronger generalisation from composition-aware neural models.
engineering_relevance: Provenance-aware testing can help engineers select models for genuinely new solar-cell recipes and fabrication settings rather than familiar historical devices.
method: Map institutional provenance in the Perovskite Database.
Apply grouped splits that progressively isolate duplicate devices, publications and institutions.
Benchmark 13 models and assess feature importance.
evidence_signal: Nearly two-thirds of curated devices share an exact recipe with another; tree ensembles lead on random splits but lose their advantage on unseen institutions and future discoveries.
watch_item: Reliable implementation depends on accurate recipe matching and provenance metadata, whose completeness is not quantified in the abstract.
paper_title: Provenance-grouped protocol for evaluating machine learning in perovskite photovoltaics
